stem.text: A bolt is subjected to a tensile force, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a bolt with a tensile force arrow pointing outwards at each end. The left end is a wider flange labelled X and marked 2d; the shaft is labelled bolt and marked d; the right end is labelled Y.

stem.text: The bolt has a circular cross-section. At end X, the diameter is $2d$. At end Y, the diameter is $d$.
What is the ratio $\dfrac{\text{stress at Y}}{\text{stress at X}}$?
